posts.title: PPF vs ceramic vs wax
posts.caption:
PPF, ceramic ka wax? 30 second madhe samja. 👇

🛡️ PPF — a physical film. Stops stone chips and scratches, self-heals. Lasts years. Best for new cars and highway drivers.
💎 Ceramic coating — a hard glossy layer. Easy washing, deep shine, protects from sun and dust. No protection from chips.
🧴 Wax — shine for a few weeks. Lowest cost, shortest life.

Swipe for the full comparison and save this for later. 📌

posts.title: Cleaning firecracker ash without scratches
posts.caption:
Raakh pusu naka! Aadhi he kara. 🧨🚫

After Diwali, firecracker ash and dust sit on your paint. Wiping it dry drags grit across the clear coat and leaves scratches.

The right way:
1️⃣ Rinse with plenty of water first
2️⃣ Foam or pH-neutral shampoo
3️⃣ Clean microfibre, straight lines, no circles

Or let us do it: post-Diwali deep clean from ₹{{PRICE_DEEPCLEAN_FROM}}. Comment CLEAN.

posts.title: Driving safely in fog
posts.caption:
Dhukyat gaadi chalavtana ya 4 chuka karu naka. 🌫️

1️⃣ High beam in fog — it reflects back and blinds you. Use low beam + fog lamps.
2️⃣ Worn wipers — replace them before winter.
3️⃣ Foggy windscreen — AC on, fresh-air mode, demister on.
4️⃣ Tailgating — keep double the usual distance.

posts.title: PPF myths vs facts
posts.caption:
PPF baddal 4 gairsamaj. ❌✅

❌ "PPF turns yellow" — good TPU film stays clear for years.
❌ "Ceramic is scratch-proof" — it isn't; only PPF stops chips.
❌ "All PPF is the same" — TPU and cheaper TPH films are very different.
❌ "Warranty doesn't matter" — always ask for the warranty card.
